Thermaltake MEKA G-Unit (060b:5253), firmware 1.35: vendor control requests captured with USBPcap.
Windows vendor software v1.2 (MEKA G Unit HID.exe), unless noted. Time in seconds from the first request
of each section; "> bm req wValue wIndex wLength" for host to device, "<" for a read, followed by the data.
See devices/meka-g-unit.md and host-to-device/README.md.


== 1. Read-only requests sent by a test program (the vendor software never reads)
   Profile 1 holds one macro on T1; profiles 2 and 3 were never written (macro index all ff).
   The last read (13 on profile 3) never got an answer, and the firmware hung until it was unplugged:
   never read 13 on a profile whose index is ff.
